title: 第7588章 赏赐第7587章 武仙组
slug: 万古第一神第7596章第三轮
content_zh:
此时的李天命和姬银妍眼神相对，皆是战意升腾。
一场大战，即将一触即发！
然而就在这时……
“慢着。”
一道男声忽然从姬银妍身后响起。
在场众人皆是一脸诧异，纷纷朝声音的来源看去。
紧接着，姬银妍身后忽然有一位神秘人缓缓上前。
全场寂静，而他不急不忙地横在了两人中间，似乎阻断了这场战斗。
身为‘武仙组’的成员，其实力自然不是万宗帝战的参战者能比的，他有绝对的底气不被两人出手而误伤。
李天命诧异看向对方，稍微地打量了一眼。
即使是在迷雾笼罩下，他也似乎隐约能看出来，其观自在界下的身影颀长，且比例绝佳，举手投足之间有种独特气质。
而随着此人的出现，姬银妍微微一愣，随即好似想到了什么，脸色变化得稍微有点不好看。
但是即便如此，从其眼底的复杂之色也看得出来，她在忍耐。
毕竟她还要通过武仙组这几人的考核，自然不能不尊敬对方。
这一位武仙组成员一身迷雾缭绕，完全看不清楚面容，而在迷雾下，他似乎微微转过身，竟然是面对着姬玄鉴。
姬银妍一行人似乎并不意外，但万曜等人纷纷皱眉，更搞不清楚如今的状况。
“小玥，我真的没想到，你竟然会放弃这个难得的机会，刚听说的时候，我都怀疑传话之人搞错了。”这神秘身影缓缓开口，似乎也能听出来语气的一丝无奈。
“本公主的想法，要是能被随便猜到的话，我便不是我了，你‘武雉’猜不到的事情还多着呢！”姬玄鉴双手抱胸，微微扭过头，似乎有点不愿面对对方。
“想想你的父皇吧，你考虑过这样任性的代价吗？”武雉低语，以一种几乎只有两人能听到的声音道，“我身后之人身为你宗室成员，若是被选为武仙组成员而得势，甚至有可能威胁到你父亲的皇位，若有那天，你想到今时的决定，是否后悔？”
“人这一辈子长得很，谁敢对未来的事情下定论？时光荏苒，有多少天才逆天崛起，又有多少天才陨落？我有我自己的路要走，他人也有他人的命数，我无悔！”姬玄鉴似有几分倔强地说道。

武雉微微叹气，接着低声说道，“事到如今，武仙组的考察对象已经定了，我也没办法把你再换回来，但我至少可以不让你的族系陷入劣势，只需要你点头。”
姬玄鉴眼中闪过了几分意外，她虽然平时大大咧咧，但是也不蠢。
她瞬间明白了，武雉这是要使用自己的权利，让姬银妍不通过考核。
这样的话，虽然姬玄鉴没能加入武仙组，但姬银妍也没有得势的可能，渊亲王和乾烽天帝之间的地位都不变。
如此，表面上看来，算是对姬玄鉴，甚至对乾烽天帝而言最有利的结果了。
然而，出乎武雉预料的是，姬玄鉴果断地摇了摇头。
“为什么？”武雉语气不解，又接着道，“这样一来，你可以去做自己想做的事，你父皇的皇位也稳固，为何不接受？”
这选择，让武雉都很诧异。
content_en:
At this time, Li Tianming and Ji Yinyan looked at each other, both with fighting intentions rising.
A war is about to break out!
But at this moment...
"Wait a minute."
A male voice suddenly sounded from behind Ji Yinyan.
Everyone present looked surprised and looked towards the source of the sound.
Immediately afterwards, a mysterious person suddenly came forward slowly behind Ji Yinyan.
The whole place was silent, and he calmly stepped between the two of them, seemingly blocking the fight.
As a member of the 'Wuxian Group', his strength is naturally not comparable to that of the participants in the Wan Zong Emperor War. He has absolute confidence not to be accidentally injured by the two of them.
Li Tianming looked at the other party in surprise and looked at him briefly.
Even under the fog, he seemed to be able to vaguely see that his figure under the Guanzui Realm was tall and tall, with excellent proportions, and a unique temperament in his movements.
As this person appeared, Ji Yinyan was slightly startled, and then she seemed to have thought of something, and her face changed slightly unsightly.
But even so, it can be seen from the complicated look in her eyes that she is enduring.
After all, she still has to pass the assessment of these people in the Martial Arts Group, so she naturally has to respect them.
This member of the Martial Arts Group was shrouded in fog, and his face could not be seen clearly. Under the fog, he seemed to turn around slightly, and he was actually facing Ji Xuanjian.
Ji Yinyan and others did not seem surprised, but Wan Yao and others frowned, and they were even more confused about the current situation.
"Xiao Yue, I really didn't expect that you would give up this rare opportunity. When I first heard about it, I suspected that the person who sent the message was wrong." The mysterious figure spoke slowly, and it seemed that a hint of helplessness could be heard in his tone.
"If my princess' thoughts can be casually guessed, I won't be me anymore. There are still many things that you, 'Wu Pheasant', can't guess!" Ji Xuanjian crossed his arms and turned his head slightly, as if he didn't want to face the other party.
"Think about your father. Have you ever considered the price of such willfulness?" Wu Zhi whispered, in a voice that almost only two people could hear, "The person behind me is a member of your clan. If he is selected as a member of the Wu Immortal Group and becomes powerful, he may even threaten your father's throne. If that day comes, do you regret your decision now?"
"People grow very long in this life, who dares to draw conclusions about the future? Time flies, how many geniuses have risen against the odds, and how many geniuses have fallen? I have my own way to go, and others have their own destiny. I have no regrets!" Ji Xuanjian said somewhat stubbornly.
Wu Zhi sighed slightly, and then whispered, "Now that the Wuxian Group's inspection target has been decided, I can't change you back, but I can at least prevent your clan from falling into a disadvantage. All I need is your nod."
A bit of surprise flashed in Ji Xuanjian's eyes. Although she was usually careless, she was not stupid either.
She instantly understood that Wu Pheasant wanted to use his power to make Ji Yinyan fail the test.
In this case, although Ji Xuanjian failed to join the Wuxian group, Ji Yinyan had no possibility of gaining power, and the status between Prince Yuan and Emperor Qianfeng remained unchanged.
In this way, on the surface, it seems to be the most beneficial result for Ji Xuanjian and even Emperor Qian Fengtian.
However, to Wu Pheasant's expectation, Ji Xuanjian shook his head decisively.
"Why?" Wu Zhi said in a puzzled tone, then continued, "In this way, you can do what you want, and your father's throne is stable, so why don't you accept it?"
This choice surprised Wu Pheasant.
